purpose: Support trader research and decision-making through evidence-labelled signals, risk controls, paper execution and honest net-economic evaluation.
success_criteria: Risk-aware net economic results are evaluated on future observations after realistic costs.
NO_TRADE and CASH are valid outcomes; the system does not force a recommendation.
Historical replay, deterministic fixture, local paper, prospective observation and independent attestation remain distinct evidence classes.

business_objective.objective: Positive expected and realized prospective risk-adjusted net value after full costs.
business_objective.evaluation_basis: Future portfolio observations after fees, spread, slippage, market impact, financing and applicable taxes, compared with a risk-matched benchmark and uncertainty reported.
business_objective.evidence_boundary: Historical replay and local simulation can inform the objective but cannot establish realized prospective profitability or verified live fills.

desks.execution_mechanics: Exchange-traded share quantities and executable quote assumptions.
Exchange-traded share quantities, session-aware quotes, fees and simulated fills.
Contract- and lot-aware multi-leg simulation with executable leg prices and explicit expiry/settlement risk.
Exchange-traded whole units; executable market prices are distinct from NAV and underlying index values.
NAV- and cutoff-based order lifecycle; never exchange ticks, intraday matching or assumed same-day fills.

shared_invariants: Signals identify their strategy version, decision clock, evidence class, risk decision, cost assumptions and invalidation/exit policy.
Paper books are auditable and reconcile cash, holdings, costs and realized/unrealized P&L.
Unresolved fills, positions, costs, data rights or source provenance block profitability claims.
A charter or software test does not establish a profitable trading edge.
explicit_non_goals: Guaranteed returns or forced daily recommendations
Treating exchange prices and mutual-fund NAV as interchangeable execution prices
